title: Report Widgets: Put Reports on the Admin Dashboard | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
The admin dashboard is the first page your team sees. Report widgets put a CrestApps report on it as a tile that follows the clock, for a period such as the last 30 days, and check that each viewer may open the report. This video shows the Report widget for the built-in reports, and the Custom Report widget for reports built in the Report Builder.

In this video:
• Why report widgets
• Turning on the Admin Dashboard and opening its editor
• Adding a Report widget: report, period, what to show, rows and cache time
• What a tile shows, and Open the full report
• The Custom Report widget for Report Builder reports
• What each person sees when they may not open a report
